claim_boundary: This establishes a controlled functional distributed J-space analogue. It is not an experiment on production language models and does not establish shared phenomenal consciousness, sentience, valence, moral status, or subjective merging.
scientific_interpretation: In this synthetic benchmark, two independently parameterized Jacobian-discovered local workspaces are aligned into a dynamic sparse union-of-cones that is reportable to both agents, bidirectionally writable, flexibly reusable, planner-causal, pair-provenance-bound, and recurrently updated by joint outcomes.
